automation.example.com {
    # gryonixnexus: n8n
    @gryonixnexus_open path /webhook/* /webhook-test/*
    handle @gryonixnexus_open {
        reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8099
    }
    handle {
        import /etc/caddy/gryonixnexus-admin-guard
        forward_auth 127.0.0.1:8094 {
            uri /api/authz/forward-auth
            copy_headers Remote-User Remote-Groups Remote-Name Remote-Email
        }
        reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8099
    }
}
